subject: The one feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: Sarah almost deleted the app until she discovered this buried setting. It completely changed her relationship. Don't make her mistake.
body_paragraphs: Sarah emailed me last month ready to quit. She said SoulPlan felt like just another chore. Her dates with Mark were still feeling... scheduled. Like checking boxes. Then she found something buried in settings most people scroll right past.

She told me it transformed their Thursday night from 'meh' to memory-making. Instead of just picking a date idea, she used it to create a surprise within a surprise. Mark thought they were just getting tacos. He had no idea she'd layered in a secret challenge that made him laugh so hard he cried. That night, she said, felt like their third date all over again.

The feature she almost missed? The 'Add a Twist' toggle inside the Surprise Date Planner. It's not just 'plan a date.' It's 'plan a date PLUS a secret mission, an inside joke, or a tiny dare.' It's the layer that turns an activity into your story. Most people use the planner to hide the location. The magic happens when you hide the little surprise inside it.

Open SoulPlan right now. Go to 'Plan a Surprise Date' and tap the little magic wand icon before you finalize. Add one sentence. One inside joke. One 'remember when.' That's the hack. P.S. The couples who use this? They're the 8% who never complain about routine. Because they broke the algorithm and started writing their own script.
